title: RBI Penalty Order on Hinduja Leyland Finance Limited for Non-Compliance with Microfinance Pricing and Securitisation Directions
description: <cite index="18-6,19-5,19-7">RBI imposed a monetary penalty of ₹6.20 lakh on Hinduja Leyland Finance Limited for non-compliance with provisions on Pricing of Microfinance Loans and Securitisation of Standard Assets, as the company failed to put in place a Board-approved policy on pricing of microfinance loans and undertook synthetic securitization activities that did not comply with RBI directions</cite>.
